chunks: So I call the placement of the stars to witness --

key_terms.مَوَاقِعِ النُّجُومِ: Places or settings of the stars

ai.seo_question: What does the oath by the 'mawaqic al-nujum' (places of the stars) in Surah Al-Waqi'ah refer to?
ai.summary: In this verse, Allah swears by the 'mawaqie' (stations or settings) of the stars, a term that Shia exegetes often link to the precise celestial order and the fixed orbits established by divine decree. This oath serves to emphasize the certainty of the Resurrection, contrasting the observable regularity of the cosmos with the inevitable reality of the Hereafter where humanity will be divided into three distinct groups.
